capabilities: Suggest tag-specific properties at the top of the native Add property list
Apply configured property types (Text, Number) when a suggestion is selected
Match rules against frontmatter and inline tags, including nested tags by default
Hide plugin-managed property candidates from notes that match no rule
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README. Relies on internal APIs (AbstractInputSuggest, metadataTypeManager.setType) that are not a stable contract and may break in future Obsidian releases; the plugin degrades gracefully with a console warning. Property types written to types.json are global across the vault. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Dynamic Properties extends Obsidian's native property-name suggestions based on the tags of the current note.
motivation: The author built it to solve their own workflow need, calling it a small AI-assisted plugin.
problem: The native property editor offers the same suggestion list for every note, so note types defined by tags cannot surface their own property candidates.
summary: Tag-aware property suggester that extends Obsidian's native property-name suggestions with per-tag configured properties and types.
